content: अपवर्तनम् .²1 Removal, transferring from one place to another; स्थान˚. .²2 Taking away, depriving one of; न त्यागोऽस्ति द्विषन्त्याश्च न च दायापवर्तनम् <ls>Ms. 9. 79</ls>. .²3 Abridging, abbreviation. .²4 Reducing a fraction to its lowest terms; division without remainder, or the divisor itself.
